profile.headline: AR Engineer - Spectacles AR Glasses
profile.summary:
AR Engineer focusing on research prototyping and production features for AR glasses
Research focus intersects UX and learning science for intuitive 3D interactive environments
Trained in AR/VR development, quant/qual UX research/design, and 3D interaction workflows
Proficient with TypeScript, C#, Lens Studio, Unity, Android, GCP, BQ, SQL, Looker, Figma
Goal is to help define the next-gen computer system interface of AR/VR technology

positions.title: Augmented Reality Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Currently working on Core UI/UX for Spectacles AR glasses
Developing World AR features (CV/ML/LiDAR) for Lens Studio in JavaScript, metrics in BigQuery SQL
Responsible for design, development, and testing of Custom Location Creator Lens

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
Developing and delivering instruction for immersive technology prototyping (3D/AR/VR)
Full life-cycle research on collaborative and educational VR apps for HCI and learning science

positions.title: Associate Director - MIXR Lab
positions.description:
Managed team of researchers, engineers and designers for 3D/AR/VR R&D projects
Funded 2019 by NJ DOE for development of secondary VR curriculum for national release
Funded 2018 by Oculus Education for VR collaboration environments for STEM undergraduates
Funded 2017 by Oculus Education for VR integration in secondary STEM education

positions.title: Virtual Reality Developer - Vision and Neural Engineering Lab
positions.description:
Built project that won “Most Innovative Breakthrough” European Auggie Award at 2018 AWE EU
Designed specs for implementing analog vision therapy into a virtual reality vision therapy game
Developed application with C# in Unity, conducted user testing for build iterations

positions.title: Adjunct Instructor and Advisory Board Member
positions.description:
Instructed programming and production classes 
Advised on industry and curriculum trends for the video game development program

positions.title: Software Engineer - Interactive Experiences at MSG Ventures
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Building development platform for internal and third-party developers for MSG Sphere in Vegas and London
Developing immersive massive-multiplayer experiences and toolsets for user testing in remote and live scenarios

positions.title: Lead 3D Designer / VR Prototyper
positions.description:
Prototyped 3D UI/UX concepts communicating product team wireframes to development team
Developed interactive VR experiences with C# in Unity for Daydream, GearVR, and Cardboard
Designed 3D content for mixing CG and video content into interactive VR experiences

positions.title: Senior Interactive Designer / Developer
positions.description:
Developed 3D mobile training applications using C#, Unity, Maya, Blender, Adobe Suite
Designed UX/UI, and 3D graphics of the training applications

positions.title: Educational Game Producer
positions.description:
Managed development cycle for public school STEM knowledge testing games
Pitched concepts, designs and full proposals to senior directors for next cycle development
Created storyboards, concept designs, and mechanics play tested on groups of students

positions.title: Visiting Game Development Instructor
positions.description:
Instructed and developed curriculum in programming, graphics and game design courses
Coordinated online curriculum deployments of course management systems

positions.title: Lead 3D Developer
positions.locationName: US Army ARDEC, Picatinny Arsenal, Dover, NJ
positions.description:
Developed 3D interactive training simulators in Unity for web and desktop deployment 
Directed client requirement, scope analysis, team management, and game engine integration
Designed the UI/UX, training content and graphic elements of the training applications

positions.title: 3D Computer Graphics Supervisor
positions.description:
Built production pipeline workflows for online studio production and team collaboration 
Directed supervisors for modeling, rigging, animation, lighting, compositing departments

positions.title: 3D Interactive Developer
positions.description:
Developed prototype interactive trainer in Unity for US Army winning a $2.5 million contract
Developed installation trainer in UDK for training doctors on Parkinson’s treatment
Created 3D graphics and UI in Maya, Photoshop, After Effects, Unity, UDK

positions.title: Assistant Regional Manager
positions.description:
Managed sales teams for container shipping from South/Central America to North America
Developed sales strategies using SQL data analysis tools

honors.title: Patent WO2023107932A1 - 3D Models for Augmented Reality (AR)
honors.issuer: Issued by US Patent and Trademark Office · Jan 2023

honors.title: Unity's Outstanding Impact on Reach Award
honors.description: As a Unity Certified Instructor, I was awarded based on the amount of research papers I published on AR/VR educational technology and the audience of my YouTube lecture series on 3D/AR/VR development in Unity.

publications.title: Travel Kinematics In Virtual Reality Increases Learning Efficiency
publications.publisher: IEEE Symposium on Visual Languages and Human-Centric Computing (VL/HCC) 2021 · Oct 1, 2021

publications.title: Pre-college Computer Science Initiative for Augmented and Virtual Reality Development
publications.publisher: IEEE Integrated STEM Education Conference (ISEC) 2020 · Aug 1, 2020
